correctness.rationale: Exact polynomial coordinate identity was reconstructed from original ODE and independently checked. At the Hopf value linear spectrum is ±iw/σ, -1 and growth 3δ. Second harmonic A2=i(λ-iw)/(3ω), stable mean z=2λr² and resonant cubic balance give r²=3δ/(2λc)+o(δ), negative real cubic -2λc, and imaginary cubic 2λw-2(λ²+w²)/(3ω). Physical-time inversion gives stated period slope, confirmed by numerical periodic-orbit shooting. The sharp sign criterion follows from intersecting w²>σλ²/(λ-3) with 0<w²<3(λ+1)², and a cubic with one positive zero.

value.rationale: At fixed α+β and the same Hopf mutation threshold, two positive cyclic competition asymmetries generate opposite physical-time period shifts, separated by a unique sharp minimum competition strength.
